overview.text: The fund reported a net asset value (NAV) per share of USD 10.82 (F1). For the 2025 period, the fund's net return was 4.1%, which was lower than the benchmark return of 4.8% (F2, F3).

The fund's modified duration was 5.6 years (F4), indicating its sensitivity to interest rate changes. Additionally, the five largest holdings accounted for 28% of net assets (F5), reflecting a moderate level of concentration. The document includes a standard disclaimer that past performance does not guarantee future returns (F6).
